utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I hope the repair drive is well-organized. Do we have enough tools and materials for everyone?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Gus offered to lend some tools, so that should help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that's good to know. I just worry about having enough for everyone who shows up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Quinn, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this weekend? I think it's a great idea to help each other out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Tess! It's this Saturday. Could you help spread the word? The more hands, the better!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing, Quinn! I've already told a few folks. What time should I tell them to show up?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great! I've never been to one before. What should I bring or do to help out?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Just bring yourself and a willingness to learn! They usually provide tools and materials, but you might want to wear old clothes in case things get messy.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks Jules! That's reassuring. What time does it start on Saturday, and where exactly should I meet everyone?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Dane, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday? It's at the community center from 10 to 4, fixing donated electronics.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh hey Vik, thanks for the heads-up. I was just asking Cleo about the supplies too—sounds like we're all getting on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, Cleo's on board too—she's gathering the tools. So it's this Saturday, 10 to 4 at the community center, fixing electronics and small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So volunteers fix items for free—do I need to bring my own tools, or will they be provided?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I think they'll have tools there, but you might want to bring your own just in case.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Okay, I'll bring my own tools just to be safe. What kinds of items are usually brought in?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Kira! The repair drive is this Saturday at the community center—everyone brings broken items and we fix them together. It's a great way to save things and meet neighbors!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are people really showing up with their broken stuff? I'm not sure if that'll actually work.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely! Last time we had a great turnout—people brought lamps, chairs, even a blender. It works because everyone lends a hand.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, the repair drive is on the 15th in the west lot. I've got it marked on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I'll be there to help out. Let me know if you need me to bring any tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam. I think we have enough tools, but bring a wrench just in case. See you on the 15th.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, Sunday afternoon works for me! What time should I show up for the painting and landscaping?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Let's say 2 PM on Sunday. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 2 PM on Sunday sounds perfect! I'll be there. Anything I should bring?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I have a list somewhere... or maybe I lost it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's definitely in the west lot on the 15th. I always double-check the map.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, west lot on the 15th! That sounds right. Thanks for remembering, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Noah, have you heard anything about the repair drive? I remember someone mentioned it starts around 9 AM.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I think Vik said it's at 10, but my memory's a bit fuzzy.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Huh, that's odd. I swear the flyer said 9, but maybe I misread it. Either way, I'll just show up early to be safe.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Mara, glad you're here! I've been tallying up the supplies for the repair drive. We're a bit short on nails, but plenty of paint.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Good to know about the nails shortage. By the way, Jules and I planned to meet at 10 AM on Saturday at the community center—does that still work for you?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, 10 AM on Saturday at the community center works great for me. I'll bring the supply list.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Leo, I heard about the repair drive too. Need any tools? I've got plenty.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, bring a hammer and screwdriver. Starts at 9.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Alright, I'll bring both. See you at 9.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it's this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4. We're fixing up donated electronics and small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, if you need any help organizing or spreading the word, just let me know!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Rosa! So it's Saturday from 10 to 4 at the community center. We'll be fixing electronics and small appliances. Your help spreading the word would be great!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, Pia. Is the repair drive still on the 15th in the west lot?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it's still on the 15th in the west lot. I hope they have enough supplies and a clear schedule.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, I'll mark it on my calendar then. Thanks, Pia.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I see... well, I hope we hear something soon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, are you talking about the repair drive? I just heard about it too—sounds like a great way to meet people!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I suppose it is... though I'm not much for socializing these days.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I was supposed to organize something, but I can't quite remember the details. Did we already talk about this?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, Oren, you're the organizer and you can't remember? Are you sure this thing is actually happening?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I know, I know—I really should remember these things. But I'm pretty sure the drive is on, I just... lost the note with the date. Let me check my pockets.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Rey, do you know what time the repair drive starts?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think it starts at 10, but I should check the flyer again.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, I'll double-check my flyer too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, are you planning to join the repair drive this Saturday? We're meeting at 10 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I thought it started at 9. But maybe the notice was different.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hmm, I'm pretty sure it's 10 at the community center, but let me double-check the flyer just to be safe.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mara, I heard about the repair drive. I've got plenty of tools in my garage if you need to borrow any.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus! That would be great—we could really use extra tools. We're meeting at the community center at 10 AM on Saturday if you want to join.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, I'll bring my toolbox and meet you there at 10.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Mina, I'm glad you're here. I've been organizing supplies for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what exactly do you need for this repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We need tools like hammers, screwdrivers, and wrenches, plus materials like wood, nails, and paint. Anything you can spare would help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Actually Tess, I confirmed it's in the west lot, not by the park.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks for the correction, Opal! I must have mixed it up. Good thing you're on top of it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No problem, Tess. I just like to keep things straight.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive! I think I had something else that day, but maybe I can swing by later.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, hope you can make it! I'll be there from 10 AM, fixing benches and maybe grabbing a bite after.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I'll try to stop by after lunch. Just don't rely on me being super punctual, you know how it is.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Faye, I heard about the repair drive. Need any help?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Sam! Yeah, the drive's this Sunday afternoon for painting and landscaping. I'm planning to stop by after the kids' soccer games — want to join?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I'll be there. Just tell me what time and where to meet.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, sorry I'm late, Hana. What's the update on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I've been talking with Mara and Mina to understand the repair drive better. It sounds like a community event where we fix broken items together, but I'm still checking the specifics to make sure everything's clear.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Mara and Mina, huh? Sounds like you've been doing the legwork. Let me know if you need a hand figuring out the details.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
